items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Gussie Miller, Tom Brown, Arnold Larkana, Bill Lambert, and myself.

ctx.x: And there'd be a colored band, and then there'd be a white band, and maybe four more colored bands. All trying to out blast each other, see? So then we let, I last on with, with, with Red, Tom Brown. Mm-hmm. And we, playing around, playing here and playing there, playing the university, we played these, uh, I'd watch these, uh, social column, you know? Who's gonna give a dance, who's, who's getting engaged and all that. You know, I had nothing to do, so I didn't go to work in any place. Tom was a tinsmith.
